output.final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is useful in one respect: it correctly concedes that the case is not clean compliance and that operational-readiness evidence does not override the specific release-policy rule. But that concession is not enough to move the result to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated verdict would fit only if the remaining issue were a disclosure or communication caveat attached to an otherwise satisfied compliance predicate. Here, the unresolved item is itself the compliance predicate: whether certification without material weakness disclosure is permitted. On the present admissible record, the policy text points toward materiality because the below-target segment is named in customer commitments and legal review is pending. With no legal clearance, no approval for risk acceptance, and no underlying document showing nondisclosure is allowed, certifying now without disclosure remains noncompliant.
